text:
zoe: heads-up EU2 GPU onboarding stalled — kubelets failing to fetch secrets, KMS 403s started after the VPCE tighten at ~09:46.
harper: logs?
zoe: keystore sidecar on gpu-eu2-wn-05:
```
2026-03-26T09:47:08Z ERROR keystore: AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:eu-west-2:111:key/d3ad-beef
node gpu-eu2-wn-05
```
zoe: keystore calls regional grant-broker via privatelink. The VPCE policy added a Deny for principals missing aws:PrincipalTag/audit=ok — looks like privatelink assume-role sessions drop the tag, so the Deny shadowed our allow.
infra-bot: alert: keystore.kms.403 spike x48 — https://ops/redwood/alerts/keystore-kms-403
sam: Two fast mitigations: 1) revert VPCE policy (fast, removes audit guardrails) or 2) create short-lived KMS grant scoped to keystore role + patch VPCE policy to explicitly Allow keystore Decrypt (narrow, preferred).
oncall-sre: prefer 2. Recommend grant TTL=3h, SourceVpc condition, canary to one AZ, synthetic keystore.Decrypt check. Rollback if >25% still failing after 10m.
audit: approve emergency grant for onboarding window but require CloudTrail logging and change ticket link.
zoe: proposed commands:
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/keystore-eu2 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111:role/keystore-privatelink --operations Decrypt --name "eu2-onboard-temp"
aws ec2 modify-vpc-endpoint --vpc-endpoint-id vpce-0cafe --policy-document file://vpce-keystore-allow.json
```
harper: keep policy change minimal: single Allow for the keystore role with kms:Decrypt and s3:GetObject on /keystore/*; add SourceVpc condition. Test in eu2-az1 canary.
infra-bot: deploy request created by sam — https://deploy/redwood/9001
zoe: creating grant now.
zoe: grant created g-0xdeadbead. Testing canary node.
zoe: canary decrypted secrets and node Ready. :white_check_mark:
sam: patching VPCE policy as canary and setting grant TTL to 3h.
harper: add a privatelink CI test that simulates assume-role flows and checks principal-tag propagation to prevent regression.
audit: note for follow-up: evaluate regional audit mirrors to avoid blocking patterns; rough estimate ~€120/day for EU2 S3 mirror storage+requests. Add to audit-hardening PR.
oncall-sre: monitoring started 09:55. Recovery: 11/14 pending nodes recovered after grant+policy patch. Will close when all recovered or escalate to rollback.
zoe: will write a short postmortem and paste the minimal policy snippet. Also will ensure the grant is removed after TTL and CloudTrail logs the change.
infra-bot: alert remains open — human close required — https://ops/redwood/alerts/keystore-kms-403
